SPECIFICATION FOR 
DELIVERY PRESSING ROLLER BOSS FOR JUTE DRAWING FRAME 



1. Scope — Prescribes the requirements for deiivery pressing roller boss for use in jute drawing 
frames. 

2. Manufacture 

2.1 Material — Boss of deiivery pressing roller shall be manufactured from mild steel. 

2.2 Treatment — Shall be case hardened. The hardness shall be within 58 to 62 HRC when determined 
in accordance with 15:1586-1968 ^Method for Rockwell hardness test ( B & C scales ) for steel 
(first revision y. 

3. Dimensional Requirements 

3.1 Nominal — The nominal dimensions shall be as per the agreement between the manufacturer and 
the user. In the absence of any agreement, these shall be declared by the manufacturer. 

3.1.1 Tolerance — The nominal dimensions shall be subject to the following tolerances ( see Fig. 1 ). 




FIG. 1 DELIVERY PRESSING ROLLER BOSS FOR JUTE DRAWING FRAME

IS : 12307 - 1tt8 

4. Marking — Each boss shall be legibly marked with manufacturer's name or trade-mark. 
4.1 Standard Marking — Details available with the Bureau of Indian Standards. 

5. Sampling — Unless otherwise agreed to between the buyer and the seller, to ascertain the 
conformity of delivery pressing roller boss to the requirements of this specification, single sampling 
plan with Inspection level I and Acceptance Quality Level ( AQL ) of 15 percent as given in "hrtsles 1 
and 2 of IS : 2500 ( Part 1 )-1973 'Sampling inspection tables : Part I Inspection by attributes and by 
count of defects ( first revision )' shall be followed, 

6. Packing — Delivery pressing roller boss shall be suitably packed to ensure complete protection 
from rust. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard has been published with a view to provide guidance to the manufacturers and 
users of delivery pressing roller boss for jute drawing frame. It is hoped that it would ensure the 
manufacture of delivery pressing roller boss of acceptable quality leading to improved functioning of 
the drawing frames. 



Printed at Arcee Press, New Delhi, India
